assignment: Real-send brief: (a) ChatController.create params contract + can a member [read,write,chat] token create; (b) claude adapter/Recorder approval-mint path — which modes, which prompts; (c) spend cap / admission limit a scripted drive could trip; (d) can mobile deep-open a session by id (archive-then-verify ordering)?
verdict: All four answered from origin/main + live read-only probes. THREE premise corrections: (1) guerrilla ALREADY runs managed claude runtimes (39 live sessions, cwd=/opt/barkpark/api, one at $263.81) — the 'no claude CLI in any baked image' premise is false for guerrilla; (2) spend is NOT cents — the cheapest real 1-message haiku session on guerrilla cost $0.342; (3) ALLOWING an ExitPlanMode card auto-flips the session to mode 'auto' (recorder.ex:1770/1776-1778) in cwd /opt/barkpark/api — the production checkout. The drive must DENY plan cards and only ALLOW a non-ExitPlanMode ask.

recipes.claim: ChatController.create body = {provider?, execution_target?, execution_host_id?, mode?, model?, effort?} and NOTHING else (unknown key => 400); id server-minted; cwd always Runtime.cwd(provider); default mode 'plan' for claude; bypassPermissions stripped from the create allowlist

A member-shaped [read,write,chat] token CAN create — RequireChatAccess resolves 'chat' + non-nil workspace_id to {:workspace, ws}; a chat token with NO workspace binding is 403; admin resolves to :global. has_permission? is a bare list membership, permissions is a free-form {:array,:string}

recipes.claim: A turnkey workspace-bound chat token mint exists: POST /w/:ws/p/:proj/v1/chat/tokens (router.ex:2358), admin-gated, permissions HARDCODED to ['chat'] in Auth.create_chat_token/3, and it also inserts a member workspace_memberships row

recipes.claim: --permission-prompt-tool stdio ships in EVERY mode including plan, so asks reach Barkpark as control_request/can_use_tool -> {:claude_chat_permission, %{request_id, tool_name, input, title, decision_reason}}; plan mode's ExitPlanMode ask fires on EVERY plan session

Deterministic non-plan provocation: the loopback MCP allowlist is fail-closed full-name — read tools (task_ready/task_show/task_prime/bp_doc_*/bp_search_query/chat_read_tail/chat_wait_for_state) auto-approve in every mode; ANY mutating loopback tool (task_create, task_next, chat_send, chat_spawn_session, bp_auth_*) and EVERY non-loopback tool mints the card

DANGER: an ALLOWED ExitPlanMode is the plan-approve fact; the Recorder then engages Autopilot = mode 'auto' (steer + StudioChat.set_mode) — write authority in the session cwd. On guerrilla that cwd is /opt/barkpark/api, the production checkout. Only ExitPlanMode triggers it; any other allowed ask does not

recipes.claim: NO spend cap anywhere: runtime_usage.ex is append-only receipts (no cap/limit/reject leg); the launch argv carries no --max-budget-usd. The ONLY admission limit is RuntimeAdmission — node-local concurrent MANAGED runtimes, default 3, unconfigured in api/config, registered_host exempt; exhaustion => 503 runtime_capacity + Retry-After 15. No rate-limit plug on the :require_chat_access pipeline
